title: console: the approvals Override Reassign confirmation says it finalises the step and bypasses the approvers, but a reassign leaves the request pending
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-23** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes it. Paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## The finding, as measured

This card is the first of the finding's two halves. The second, OAuth's Rotate Client Secret copy, is a separate objectstack card.

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin, Setup → Approvals → a pending request → Override Reassign.
- **Actual:** the confirmation reads "Continuing uses your admin override: it finalises the step immediately and bypasses the approvers who have not acted". Reassign does not finalise the step: the request stayed Pending, and now waits on the new assignee (Priya Raman).
- **Expected:** a reassign's confirmation describes a reassign. Only a decision override says it finalises the step.
- **Evidence:** [`18-approvals-override-reassign-dialog.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/18-approvals-override-reassign-dialog.png), [`19-approvals-requests-after-override.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/19-approvals-requests-after-override.png).
- **class:** a. **Reach:** every admin.

## Seat review

- **Landing (seat review):** objectui `DeclaredActionsBar.tsx:270` and the en.ts i18n entry near 4580. The override copy is shared across override actions, whatever the action does. The report suspected `plugin-approvals`.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 1 hit in objectstack, 5 in objectui, none on point. **New.**
